About SundaySky

Since 2006, SundaySky has transformed video creation with a modular approach, making it more flexible and scalable for businesses. We pioneered AI-powered personalized video, enterprise-scale rendering, and dynamic content creation. 

Backed by a $100M investment from Clearhaven Partners in 2022, our platform puts the power of enterprise-scale video creation into the hands of Fortune 500 businesses—setting a new standard for connection in the digital age.

    The SundaySky Values

    Customer-centricity

    Our customers’ success is our primary responsibility – always. We earn trust by listening, innovating and building solutions that help every customer achieve their goals.

    Action

    We move with speed and conviction, and believe thoughtful action beats over-deliberation. Our markets are dynamic and evolving. Our motivation to act keeps us in step.

    Curiosity

    We ask questions, challenge assumptions, and seek to understand. We embrace continuous learning and experimentation to drive better outcomes.

    Determination

    We compete with urgency and intention. We set high goals and strive to achieve great outcomes for our customers and company.

    Ownership

    Every team member is accountable for outcomes and takes responsibility. When something needs doing, we step up.

    Collaboration

    We are a team, and we believe that working together produces the best results for customers. We work toward shared goals, move quickly, and rapidly learn together.

    Growth

    We are always progressing and accept that obstacles and setbacks are part of how we improve. We have faith that our resiliency and resolve will help us achieve great things.

    Candor

    We speak up, even when it’s uncomfortable. We respectfully share honest feedback with the steadfast belief that clarity and directness make us better.

    Benefits

    At SundaySky, we believe great work starts with great support. That’s why we offer comprehensive benefits to empower our team—professionally, personally, and financially—so they can bring their best self to work.

    • Competitive pay and benefits
    • Yearly bonus plan for all employees
    • Health, Dental, Vision insurance coverage (US)
    • 401K match (US)
    • Unlimited PTO policy (starting 2027)
    • Fully remote work mode in the U.S. and Israel
